newsitem.title: POLAND: New Polish business daily to be launched April 7.
newsitem.headline: New Polish business daily to be launched April 7.

text.p: Polish publisher Infor said on Thursday it would replace its economic daily Nowa Europa next month with a new paper containing more legal, equity and financial materials.
The first issue of the new daily, called Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki or the Law and Economy Journal, will be published on April 7, Infor said in a statement.

Last month Infor, owned by Polish investor Ryszard Pienkowski, extended its equity in Nowa Europa to 100 percent by buying a 51-percent stake in the daily from an Italian company publishing the Il Sole 24 Ore business paper. @

Infor said it wanted the new daily's circulation to reach 70,000 copies by the end of the year and 100,000 at the end of 1998. Nowa Europa, now published in some 45,000 copies, sells only half of them.

The new paper would borrow expertise from Infor's successful Gazeta Prawna or the Legal Gazette, which is published twice a week and has a circulation of about 90,000 copies. Gazeta Prawna will be published as a weekly as off the next month.
Infor publishes 27 periodicals, mainly economic and legal. @
